How team orders work

From roster to ready-to-wear

01

Tell us about your team

Colors, mascot, roster size, and garment styles you need — tees, hoodies, hats, or bows.

02

Pick your embellishment

Rhinestone, patch, DTF, or a mix. We match fonts and layouts to your team branding.

03

Approve your proof

We send a digital mock-up of every design before cutting rhinestones or pressing transfers.

04

We produce & ship

Bulk-priced by roster size, packed by athlete name on request, shipped or ready for pickup.
